resources.string: Lets your phone\'s own camera sign you in with a passkey QR code.\n\nMany camera apps read QR codes but don\'t understand passkey codes (the ones a computer shows when you choose \"use a phone\"). They send them to a web search instead. This app sits in front of web search: passkey codes go to your phone\'s passkey handler, and every other search goes on to your browser unchanged.
✓ Active. Web searches pass through this app.

Web searches always go to %1$s, so this app never sees them. Open %1$s\'s settings → Open by default → Clear defaults, then come back here.

How to use: on the computer, choose to sign in with a phone or another device. Scan the QR code with your camera app, then follow the prompts. Bluetooth must be on: it proves the phone is near the computer.\n\nThis app has no internet permission, keeps no data, and never shows up unless you open it.
